name: Ballista
text: Unlocks the Ballista: the longest reach of any tower. It hurls huge bolts at the toughest enemy in sight.

name: Flame Tower
text: Unlocks the Flame Tower: short range, but it scorches every enemy near it at once. Death to hound packs.

name: Bell Tower
text: Unlocks the Bell Tower: it rings, and every tower near it reloads 40% faster.

name: Mining
text: Unlocks the Mine: earns gold, and much more for every mountain around it.

name: Fishing
text: Unlocks the Fishery: earns gold, and more for every square of water around it.

name: Writing
text: Unlocks the Library: makes science, and more for every science building touching it.

name: Shield Wall
text: Unlocks the Shield Barracks: shields draw the fire of every enemy tower and take only half its damage. They hit weakly.

name: Hound Masters
text: Unlocks the Hound Yard: fast hounds dodge fights, raid houses and loot gold from every house they destroy.

name: Archery
text: Unlocks the Archery Range: archers shoot enemy units hard from 4 squares away, but barely scratch buildings.

name: Town Planning
text: Unlocks the Plaza: your city grows 2.5 times as fast around it, so you can steer where it spreads.

name: Thornwork
text: Unlocks the Thorn Wall: a tough wall that cuts every enemy who strikes it.

name: War Banners
text: Unlocks the Banner Hall: Standard Bearers march with your army, and every unit near a banner hits 25% harder and moves 15% faster.

name: Muskets
text: Unlocks the Musket Range: musketeers fire slow, huge shots that pierce armour. They hunt knights, shields and giants.

name: Printing Press
text: Unlocks the Printing Press: every press makes each future discovery 8% cheaper (up to 40%).

name: Factories
text: Unlocks the Factory: army buildings within 3 squares raise their units 50% faster.

name: Machine Guns
text: Unlocks the Machine Gun Nest: a hail of bullets that shreds unarmoured swarms at long range. Armour shrugs it off.

name: Artillery
text: Unlocks the Artillery Works: guns that outrange every tower and shell only towers.

name: Tanks
text: Unlocks the Tank Factory: armoured tanks shell units and buildings alike, and shrug off small arms.

name: Air Power
text: Unlocks the Airfield: bombers fly over walls and water and bomb the buildings deep inside a city. Only anti-air can stop them.

name: Anti-Air
text: Unlocks the AA Battery: the only tower that can shoot down aircraft. It only turns up once someone has aircraft, and then often.

name: Electricity
text: Unlocks the Power Plant: money buildings within 3 squares earn 50% more.

name: Missiles
text: Unlocks the Missile Silo: every 45 seconds a missile flies at a random building of the colony you are attacking, anywhere on the map.

name: Hexcraft
text: Unlocks the Hex Tower: every 12 seconds it bewitches a light enemy in range (45 health or less). It fights for you from then on.

name: Marksmen
text: Unlocks the Marksman Tower: long range, armour-piercing shots that pick off the back line first: monks, bearers, sappers, mages and siege engines.

name: Railguns
text: Unlocks the Railgun: a slug that tears through every enemy unit in a straight line, ten squares long.

name: Radar
text: Unlocks the Radar: every tower within 3 squares of it reaches 2 squares further.

name: Nuclear Fission
text: RARE. Unlocks the Nuke Silo: every 150 seconds a nuclear warhead flattens a whole district of the colony you are attacking.

name: Battering Rams
text: Unlocks the Ram Works: armoured rams that smash walls and buildings three times as hard. They never fight units.

name: Arcane Arts
text: Unlocks the Arcane Hall: mages hurl fireballs that burst over a whole group of enemy units. Fragile.

name: Thieves' Guild
text: Unlocks the Thieves' Guild: assassins that enemy towers cannot see until they are right beside them.

name: Gunships
text: Unlocks the Helipad: gunships fly over everything and rake enemy units with fire. Only anti-air and Center Towers can hit them.

name: Sawmills
text: Unlocks the Lumber Mill: earns gold, and more for every forest square still standing around it.

name: Granaries
text: Unlocks the Granary: earns gold for every farm of yours within 2 squares.

name: Stock Market
text: Unlocks the Stock Exchange: earns gold for every money building you own, anywhere.

name: Alchemy
text: Unlocks the Alchemist: turns gold into science, burning 0.4 gold a second for 0.6 science.

name: Universities
text: Unlocks the University: science for every house of yours within 3 squares.

name: Espionage
text: Unlocks the Spy Den: steals science from every rival still standing.

name: Blood Oath
text: All units deal 25% more damage, but have 10% less health.

name: Phalanx
text: All units have 30% more health, but move 10% slower.

name: Guild Charters
text: All buildings cost 15% less.

name: Rich Soil
text: All houses earn 25% more gold.

name: Masons' Lodge
text: All buildings, walls and towers repair themselves twice as fast.

name: Field Medicine
text: All units heal 1 health every second, even in battle.

name: Boom Town
text: Your city grows 15% faster.

name: Ballistics
text: All towers reach 1 square further and deal 10% more damage.

name: Rapid Fire
text: All towers reload 25% faster, but deal 10% less damage.

name: Standing Army
text: Every army building supports one more unit, but raises them 10% slower.

name: Enlightenment
text: All science rises by 30%, but all gold falls by 10%.

name: Mercantilism
text: All gold rises by 25%, but all science falls by 10%.

name: Reinforced Concrete
text: All buildings and walls have 40% more health, the ones standing included.

name: Assembly Lines
text: All army buildings raise units 35% faster.

name: Total War
text: All units deal 20% more damage, and 20% more again to buildings.

name: Satellites
text: All towers reach 2 squares further, the Center Tower included.

name: Automation
text: All buildings cost 25% less and are finished in half the time.

name: Forced March
text: All units move 10% faster.

name: Whetstones
text: All units deal 10% more damage.

name: Masonry
text: All buildings and walls have 25% more health, the ones standing included.

name: Trade Routes
text: All gold income rises by 10%.

name: Scribes
text: All science rises by 15%.

name: Architects
text: New buildings are finished in half the time.

name: Frost Tower
text: Unlocks the Frost Tower: every enemy in range is chilled to half speed, and strikes at half speed too.

name: Lightning Tower
text: Unlocks the Lightning Tower: a bolt that leaps from enemy to enemy, hitting up to five.

name: Shrine
text: Unlocks the Shrine: it heals your buildings, houses, tower and units nearby.

name: Trade
text: Unlocks the Market: earns gold for every house of yours around it. Build it in a busy district.

name: Astronomy
text: Unlocks the Observatory: plenty of science, and more for every mountain around it.

name: Fortification
text: Unlocks the Bastion: a wall more than three times as tough as an ordinary one.

name: Spear Throwers
text: Unlocks the Spear Hall: spearmen who, when struck, hurl a spear that pierces everything in a line.

name: Horsemanship
text: Unlocks the Stable: knights whose first strike after a gallop hits three times as hard.

name: Siege Engines
text: Unlocks the Siege Workshop: catapults that lob boulders at buildings from beyond crossbow range.

name: Monasticism
text: Unlocks the Monastery: monks who walk with your army and heal it.

name: Chainmail
text: All units have 20% more health.

name: Drill Sergeants
text: All army buildings raise units 25% faster.

name: Engineering
text: All towers reach 1 square further, the Center Tower included.

name: Clockwork
text: All towers reload 15% faster.

name: Roads
text: All units cross forest and mountains at full speed.

name: Battering Rams
text: All units deal 50% more damage to buildings.

name: Gunpowder
text: Unlocks the Cannon Tower: long-range shells that blast every enemy near where they land.

name: Obelisk
text: Unlocks the Obelisk: a beam that locks onto one enemy and burns hotter the longer it holds.

name: Banking
text: Unlocks the Bank: pays interest on the gold you have saved.

name: Academy
text: Unlocks the Academy: a great deal of science, wherever it stands.

name: Black Powder
text: Unlocks the Powder House: sappers who run at walls and blow them apart.

name: Giants
text: Unlocks the Giant's Lair: one giant at a time, enormous and slow. Its stomp hits everyone around it.

name: Conscription
text: Every army building supports one more unit.

name: Artillery
text: All towers deal 25% more damage.

name: Citadel
text: Your Center Tower has 50% more health.

name: Golden Age
text: All gold and all science rise by 15%.
